Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with a piano roll, MIDI Workbench, native ensembles and MP4 concert capture. Hosted Band adds join-code sessions with Concert Director, remote instrument and ARM controls, and scheduled playback. Includes copyable relay diagnostics, Concert Director, opt-in party follow, and Shortcut Bars. START cues now report individual follower acceptance and retransmit missing confirmations.
Changelog: Hosted Band START acknowledgement per performer, targeted retry of unconfirmed START cues using the same scheduled downbeat, duplicate prevention, and visible rejection reasons.
